structured_output.what_is_happening: MuseXT on Meteora (not pump.fun), 10.7 minutes old at detection. Price is up about 700% since launch. It has done $1.7M of volume on a ~$75-83k market cap, a 28x hourly turnover. Buys come from 1,676 unique wallets, but sells come from only 95. GMGN tags 100 bundler wallets, and bundlers make up 65% of top traders. 100% of the LP is unlocked with few LP providers. Price is already about 27% below its ATH (1.03e-4 down to 7.5e-5) by the snapshot. At least 10 other tokens share the MuseXT ticker. The leader is a pump.fun token (DVby...pump) created about 10 minutes earlier at $490k market cap with $1.1M in hourly volume. This coin looks like one of many copies riding a real or hyped MuseXT launch.

narrative.description: MuseXT looks like a project name, possibly an AI or creator product. GeckoTerminal links the X handle 'usemusext'. A cluster of same-name tokens launched within about 20 minutes, which points to a real-world trigger (an announcement or launch tweet) that sniping deployers are copying.
narrative.why_spreading: A ticker-sniping frenzy after some MuseXT mention. The attention goes to the name, not to this contract.

token_connection.why_this_token: Its only claim is the GeckoTerminal X handle 'usemusext', which anyone can set. It has no DexScreener profile, website, or socials, and it was created after the leading pump.fun MuseXT.
token_connection.competing_tokens: DVbyFeAZ...pump ($490k market cap, $71k liquidity, created about 10 minutes earlier) leads. At least 9 others exist, most already drained to $0 liquidity.

authenticity.evidence: 100 bundler wallets, and bundlers are 65% of top traders. Only 95 unique sellers against 1,676 buyers. $1.7M of volume on a $75k market cap. Unlocked LP on a Meteora pool the deployer controls. Zero smart-money or KOL wallets. The price is already fading from its ATH.
authenticity.uncertainty: The buyer count is broad. Some of the flow may be real retail confusing this coin with the canonical token.

structural_risks: 100% of LP unlocked, so the deployer can pull liquidity at any time
A bundled copycat of a ticker whose lead token is already much larger
Only 95 sellers, so the exit flow may be concentrated in the deployer's side
Already 27% off its ATH shortly after a 7x move
Several same-ticker copies have already gone to $0 liquidity

structured_output.counterargument: 1,676 unique buyers in 10 minutes is real breadth. The mint and freeze authorities are renounced, and top10 holds only 23%. If the MuseXT story blows up and confused buyers keep landing on this contract (it has the linked X handle on GeckoTerminal), a copy at $75k can still 2x toward the leader's valuation.

structured_output.thesis: This is a bundled, non-canonical MuseXT copy on Meteora with unlocked LP. It came after a larger pump.fun version and is already fading from its ATH, so a rug or bleed is far more likely than a 2x.
